{{Quote|For this one's home, for this one's people.|[[Saba Sebatyne]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] was '''captured''' by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. A significant number of the native inhabitants, the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]], were captured and placed into a [[Slaveship|slaving ship]]. At this point, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] arrived in-system. Believing her people have been murdered, as revenge she saw [[Slaveship|bloated balloon like]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] she never saw before escorted by [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]]. She first took care of coralskippers then fired her three remaining [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the big Yuuzhan Vong starship, rupturing it. Barabel bodies spewed out into the vacuum of space.
